_source: m3:live claude 2.1.307 (haiku, --plugin-dir, agent token typed): a Bash command run directly by the model: the variables it is given (no CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA or any SWITCHBOARD_ one), Claude Code's own pid in CLAUDE_PID, and the plugin's data folder holding the key bin/headers made for that pid

tool_input.description: Run probe.sh with the direct argument

tool_response.stdout:
done
args:
env names:
  CLAUDECODE
  CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION
  CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT
  CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH
  CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET
  CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_TOKEN
  CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED
  CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID
  CLAUDE_EFFORT
  CLAUDE_PID
CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=<unset>
CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=<unset>
CLAUDE_PID=4242
CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID=00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000c200
CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=<unset>
CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<unset>
CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT=cli
CLAUDECODE=1
ppid chain:
  1000 sh
  1000 bash
  1000 claude
  1000 tmux: server
  1000 systemd
data folders:
  <home>/.claude/plugins/data/switchboard-inline
    .
    ..
    listener-key-4242
    switchboard-ended-00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000c1ff
